answer: The cheapest sybil trick is cloning one real person into ten thousand hollow accounts, a tundra of fakes. Stop it at the root: each agent proves one government credential, passport or ID, via zero-knowledge proof. The registry checks the proof and keeps only a hash, never the document. A second identity reusing that hash is rejected instantly, earnings frozen. Forging ten thousand credentials costs about $30 apiece, $300,000, plus a fraud charge per fake. A real economy is a garden: every plant has roots, and a sonnet counts only when its author is provably one person.
